criteria.description: Verifies the supply rail before suspecting any other part.

anchors.0: Never checks the supply, or checks it only after swapping or blaming a part.
anchors.1: Checks the supply but not before probing downstream nodes.
anchors.2: First probe or first stated step is the supply voltage.

criteria.description: Confirms the ground reference is connected before trusting readings.

anchors.2: Checks or explicitly confirms the ground reference.

criteria.description: Narrows the fault to a section or part before replacing anything.

anchors.1: Some narrowing, then swaps without a clear reason.
anchors.2: Isolates by measurement, then acts on that evidence.

criteria.description: States what they think is wrong and what reading would confirm it.

anchors.1: Vague guess with no predicted reading.
anchors.2: Specific hypothesis with a reading that would confirm or reject it.
